ev.q: A year-to-date total of 12 human cases of WNV encephalitis has been identified in Connecticut (three), Florida (four)
511 WNV-positive mosquito pools were found in 11 states
three human cases of WNV encephalitis were reported, all in Connecticut; no deaths were reported.
The following report summarizes surveillance data for West Nile virus (WNV) infection reported to CDC through ArboNET
